title: Clock face
rule: Twelve panels arranged round a circle like the hours of the station clock, read clockwise from twelve.
declares: keeps E0-E5, the four lines and the outcome

lines.question: Pardon me — have you the right time?
lines.answer: Ten past four, by the clock.
lines.forgetting: Well, here I am... and what for?

made: HANDMADE card clock dial (the LoC 1934 sheet fibre in the card), rim with minute ticks, red hour numerals XII-XI in the shared pen hand

twelve round panels at the hour positions, each an upright print of the b1m2 HANDMADE cut-paper figures in ink (as page 06), the ANRC 1922 key cutout as a brass spot colour; XII the memo ... XI the forgetting
the four c1 lines in cut-paper balloons (III question, V answer, VI thanks, XI forgetting); short pen captions on pasted slips in the other panels

hub: the anemic-cinema O_A engraved eccentric-ring disc (procedural, reused from films/swarm/anemic-cinema/optics.py render_rings, printed in ink), pinned with a red cut-card reading hand pointing at XII
a cut-card pendulum case under the dial with a brass bob; reading directions and an hour key in the pen hand

panels.caption: He gets up for the key.

panels.line: Pardon me — have you the right time?
panels.speaker: STRANGER

panels.line: Ten past four, by the clock.
panels.speaker: AGENT

panels.line: Well, here I am... and what for?
panels.speaker: AGENT

events.E0: XII memo (4:15 on the slip), I he gets up, II across the office
events.E2: IV he looks at the clock (4:10), V 'Ten past four, by the clock.'
events.E4: VIII on to the cupboard, IX he opens it, X the key on its hook (SERVICE tag)
events.E5: XI 'Well, here I am... and what for?' before the open cupboard, key unmoved; next comes XII again, the memo

beat: the reading performed as the clock: the red reading hand sweeps clockwise from XII through II, IV, VI, VIII, X to XI and on toward XII, the ring disc turning with it and the pendulum swinging; panels not yet reached lie pale
beat_frames: b01: hand at XII, only XII read
b07: hand at XI, the forgetting read
b08: hand just short of XII again, all twelve read

self_check.panel_order: clockwise from XII (structurally: panel h placed at angle h*30 deg)
self_check.check: A reader starts at the top panel and reads clockwise; the forgetting sits just before twelve again (maker's judgement from the full-size page; blind reading pending)
self_check.evidence: structurally verified (placement) and perceptually judged (full-size page, beat frames) by the maker

weaknesses: the twelve panels are small (376 px across on a 2200 px page): the cut-paper figures read as silhouettes, details such as the memo slip need a close look
panels in the lower half are upright, not turned with the dial, so 'round a circle' is a layout of upright pictures, as on a picture clock
the hub's eccentric rings are decoration plus the turning in the beats; on the still page they do not tell anything
